习惯 xíguàn (habit; to be used to)
成 (chéng) - to become
HSK L3 Page 122
“习惯成自然”，这里“成”是变成的意思。 ("Xíguàn chéng zìrán", zhèlǐ "chéng" shì biànchéng de yìsi.) - In "习惯成自然", "成" means "to become".

这句话的意思是，平时做事的方法习惯了，慢慢就变成自然的事了，很难再改变了。 (Zhè jù huà de yìsi shì, píngshí zuò shì de fāngfǎ xíguàn le, mànmàn jiù biànchéng zìrán de shì le, hěn nán zài gǎibiàn le.) - The saying means that once the way you usually do something becomes a habit, it gradually becomes natural and hard to change.

这句话告诉我们要养成好的习惯，不要觉得不好的事情只做一次没关系，如果不注意，慢慢就会变成很自然的事，到时候就不容易发现错误，也不容易改变了。 (Zhè jù huà gàosu wǒmen yào yǎngchéng hǎo de xíguàn, bú yào juéde bù hǎo de shìqing zhǐ zuò yí cì méi guānxi, rúguǒ bú zhùyì, mànmàn jiù huì biànchéng hěn zìrán de shì, dào shíhou jiù bù róngyì fāxiàn cuòwù, yě bù róngyì gǎibiàn le.) - It tells us to form good habits and not to think a bad thing done just once does not matter; if we are not careful it gradually becomes natural, and then the mistake is hard to notice or change.
Saying: 习惯成自然 (Habit Is Second Nature)

今天没有昨天热。 (Jīntiān méiyǒu zuótiān rè.) - Today is not as hot as yesterday. (A 没有 B Adj example)
西瓜没有苹果便宜。 (Xīguā méiyǒu píngguǒ piányi.) - Watermelon is not as cheap as apple. (A 没有 B Adj example)
苹果没有西瓜大。 (Píngguǒ méiyǒu xīguā dà.) - Apple is not as big as watermelon. (negative example for pair work)
